snippet.title: Scott Pilgrim EX - Out March 3rd, 2026 - Matthew Patel and Robot-01 Join the Lineup!
snippet.description:
Save Toronto from the Vegans, Robots & Demons 👊

Two new foes turn to friends:
🔥 Firey puppet master Matthew Patel
🤖 State-of-the-art ally Robot-01

After the members of the Sex Bob-omb are kidnapped, it's up to this rag-tag bunch of exes (and a robot creation) to team up and take on a new threat in Scott Pilgrim EX

Wishlist Scott Pilgrim EX, coming digitally March 3rd, 2026 ⬇️
https://scottpilgrimex.com/
